{{Top|leg}}
The '''Triple Crown''' was a competition of the [[swoopchasing]] discipline. The Triple Crown races were held on [[Najiba/Legends|Najiba]], [[Neftali/Legends|Neftali]], [[Redcap]], and [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]]. The Socorro event, the [[Cjaalysce'I 500]], was held in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Cjaalysce'I]].<ref name="Socorro">''[[The Black Sands of Socorro]]''</ref>
